critical_issues: Critical: Severe overexposure/tone mapping causes widespread highlight clipping (large regions at pure white).
Medium: Possible geometry intersection/clipping at boundaries/contact areas (hard to confirm due to blown highlights).
warnings: Fix exposure first (before sim tuning): reduce key light/world strength and/or camera exposure by ~2–4 stops; use a filmic/photographic tone mapper to preserve highlights.

Rebuild water shading for readability: use physically-based refraction (IOR ~1.33), add subtle absorption (very light blue/green tint with depth), and introduce small roughness (e.g., 0.02–0.08) to avoid nuclear-white specular blowout.
Improve effect staging: ensure the emitter actually produces a sideways jet (emitter orientation/normals) and that the wall collider is positioned to catch the jet so you get a sheet-down behavior.
Increase simulation fidelity for thin-sheet breakup: raise domain resolution and max timesteps/substeps; reduce particle radius to avoid ‘blobby’ liquid.
Enhance whitewater/spray only after exposure is under control; otherwise particles will also clip to white and read as noise.
Add/strengthen contact shadows/AO and balanced fill lighting so cabinet interior and liquid silhouettes remain legible.
